ποῦ: ποῦ — where?; interrog. adv., in a direct question
πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πριάμῳ: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. dat. sg.
προπάροιθε: προπάροιθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., also adv.
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
πρὶν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv./conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’) · also + gen. of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς ἁλός ’toward the sea’)
πρῶτος: πρῶτος — first; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to do it)’
πτολεμίζειν: πτολεμίζω — make war, fight; pres. inf. act., epic π-τ form (= Attic πολεμίζειν)
πυκνὰ: πυκνός — thick, dense; neut. acc. pl.: ’thick’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with καρήαθ’: ’thick (heads)’
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’)
πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
πόλεμόν: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
πόνον: πόνος — toil, labor, trouble; acc. sg.
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, grave before another word) — beside, alongside; prep. + dat.: ’beside’ · also prep. + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ ποταμὸν ’beside the river’) · also prep. + gen., ’from beside’ (πὰρ Διὸς ’from Zeus’) · also adverb, ’beside him’ · also adverb, no case: ’beside, alongside’ (πὰρ δὲ … ἕστασαν ’and beside … stood’) · also prep. + gen., ’by, beside’ (πὰρ ποταμοῖο ’by the river’)
πᾶς: πᾶς, πᾶσα, πᾶν — all, whole, every; masc. nom. sg.: ’all, the whole man’
πῃ: πῃ — in some way, anywhere; enclitic adv.: οὐδέ πῃ ’not in any way’
σθένεϊ: σθένος — strength, might; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic σθένει): ’in strength’
σθένος: σθένος — strength, might; neut. nom./acc. sg.
σμερδαλέῳ: σμερδαλέος — terrible, frightful; adj., masc. dat. sg., agreeing with χαλκῷ
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
στῆθος: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’breast’ (Ἥρῃ … στῆθος ’Hera’s breast’)
σῆμα: σῆμα — sign, mark; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’sign’ · also neut. acc. sg., predicate, with κικλήσκουσιν understood: ’tomb’ (σῆμα Μυρίνης ’the tomb of Myrine’) · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’a token’ (σῆμα ἰδέσθαι ’to see the token’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’tomb’ (ἀνδρὸς τόδε σῆμα ’the tomb of a man’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of τιθείς: ’a sign, an omen’ · also neut. acc. sg., after παρά: ’tomb’ (παρ’ Ἴλου σῆμα ’past the tomb of Ilus’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τέκεσσι: τέκος — child; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic τέκνοις)
τέρενα: τέρην, τέρεινα, τέρεν — tender, soft; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl. (same form)
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’)
τίετο: τίω — honour, esteem; impf. 3 sg. pass., unaugmented (= ἐτίετο): ’was honoured’
τίπτ: τίπτε (= τί ποτε) — why ever, why then; interrog. adv., elided (τίπτ’ = τίπτε)
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τείρει: τείρω — wear down, distress; pres. 3 sg.
τελαμώνιος: Τελαμώνιος — son of Telamon (patronymic adj.); masc. nom. sg.
τελαμῶνος: τελαμών — broad strap, belt, baldric; masc. gen. sg. · also Τελαμών — Telamon, father of Ajax; masc. gen. sg.
τευ: τις, τι — someone, something; indefinite pron., masc./fem. gen. sg., epic τευ (= Attic τινός)
τεύχε: τεῦχος — armour, gear (pl. τεύχεα); neut. nom. pl., elided (τεύχε’ = τεύχεα) · also neut. acc. pl., elided: ’armour’ (τεύχε’ ἀπούρας ’having taken the armour’)
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη)
τεῦκρος: Τεῦκρος — Teucer, Greek hero at Troy, half-brother of Ajax; masc. nom. sg.
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’
τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’)
τροίης: Τροίη — Troy; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic Τροίας)
τρωσὶν: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
τυτθόν: τυτθός — small, little; neut. acc. sg. used as adv.: ’a little (way)’
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’, often with γε: ’that at least’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τό τε εἶδος ’and the looks’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg., inner object: ’which’ (ἕλκος τό μιν βάλε ’the wound with which he struck him’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, ’on that account’ (τό γε δείδιθι ’fear not on that account’) · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (βῶν ἀζαλέην, τό μοι ἔστι … ’the dry hide, which is mine to …’)
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), ’therefore, so’ · also dual acc. relative: ’whom (the two)’ (τώ μοι … γείνατο ’whom … bore for me’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), in a consequence: ’in that case, then’ (τώ κε … ἀντήσειε ’then would he meet’)
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl. as a relative, ’which’ (τὰς Εὔμηλος ἔλαυνε ’which Eumelus drove’) · also fem. acc. pl. demonstrative: ’these, them’ (τὰς διαπέρσαι ’to sack these’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὸ ποιήσαντο ’which they made’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’
τῷδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; demonstrative pron., masc. dat. sg., standing alone: ’this man’
υἷας: υἱός — son; masc. acc. pl., epic υἷας (= Attic υἱούς)
υἷες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἷες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
υἷϊ: υἱός — son; masc. dat. sg., epic υἷϊ (= Attic υἱεῖ)
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φαεινῷ: φαεινός — shining, bright, radiant; masc./neut. dat. sg.
φθογγὴν: φθογγή — voice, sound; fem. acc. sg.
φωτὶ: φώς — man, mortal; masc. dat. sg., after ἐοικώς: ’(like) a man’ · also masc. dat. sg., with μάχεσθαι: ’a man’ (ἀμείνονι φωτὶ μάχεσθαι ’to fight a better man’)
χάλκεον: χάλκεος — of bronze; neut. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκοῦν) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔγχος: ’of bronze’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σάκος: ’of bronze’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὕπνον: ’of bronze’ (χάλκεον ὕπνον ’a bronze sleep’)
χαλκοχιτώνων: χαλκοχίτων — bronze-shirted, with bronze tunics; masc. gen. pl.
χαλκὸς: χαλκός — bronze, copper; also a bronze blade; masc. nom. sg.
χθονὶ: χθών — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
χροΐ: χρώς — skin, body; masc. dat. sg., epic χροΐ (= Attic χρωτί)
χροὸς: χρώς — skin, flesh; masc. gen. sg., epic χροός (= Attic χρωτός)
χρὴ: χρή — it is necessary, one must; impersonal verb + acc. and inf.
ἀγγελίης: ἀγγελίη — message, embassy; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας), after ἕνεκα
ἀγὸς: ἀγός — leader, commander; masc. nom. sg.
ἀθηναίων: Ἀθηναῖοι — the Athenians; masc. gen. pl.
ἀκήριον: ἀκήριος — spiritless, faint-hearted (ἀ- + κῆρ ’heart’; the sense is inferred); neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δέος · also masc. acc. sg., predicate complement of τίθησι: ’spiritless’ (ἀκήριον … τίθησι ’makes spiritless, lifeless’)
ἀκωκή: ἀκωκή — point, edge; fem. nom. sg.
ἀκόντισε: ἀκοντίζω — hurl a javelin, throw a spear; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠκόντισε): ’hurled’
ἀλκῆς: ἀλκή — might, valour, prowess in battle; fem. gen. sg.
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀνδραίμονος: Ἀνδραίμων — Andraemon, father of Thoas; masc. gen. sg.
ἀντίον: ἀντίον — opposite, face to face; adv. or prep. + gen.: ’in opposition to, to the face of’
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. (ἀνὰ στρατόν ’throughout the army’) · + dat., ’upon’ (ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ ’upon a sceptre’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis: ’up, aboard’ (ἀνὰ … εἷσεν ’set aboard’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ στόμ’ ἔχων ’having on your lips, going on about’ · also with σχέο in tmesis: ’back, up’ (ἀνὰ … σχέο = ἀνάσχεο ’hold back’) · also with ἀείραι in tmesis: ’up’ (ἀνὰ … ἀείραι ’raise up’) · also + acc. of place: ’up on’ (ἀνὰ μυρίκην ’up on a tamarisk’)
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen. · also a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀπ’ … ὀμόργνυ = ἀπομόργνυ ’wiped off’) · also with a form in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπ’ αὐτόφιν ’from it’)
ἀπολέσθαι: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. ἀπόλλυμαι ’perish’; aor. mid. inf.: ’to perish’
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’) · also adv. ’away, off’ before πρό (ἀπὸ πρὸ νεῶν ’off in front of the ships’) · also + gen. of manner: ’from’ (ἀπὸ σπουδῆς ’in earnest’) · also with a noun in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπὸ νευρῆφιν ’from the string’)
ἀράβησε: ἀραβέω — clatter, rattle; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἠράβησε)
ἀραρυῖαν: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, fit; perf. part. act. fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κυνέην: ’fitted (for)’
ἀρετὴ: ἀρετή — excellence, valour; fem. nom. sg.
ἀρχοὶ: ἀρχός — leader, chief; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἂμ: ἀνά (shortened and assimilated ἂμ before π) — up, along, over, among; prep. + acc.: ’along, across, over’ · also + dat., ’along, among’ · also ἂμ before φ, prep. + acc.: ’up through’ (ἂμ φόνον ’up through the slaughter’)
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’(you) other (gods)’ (Ζεῦ ἄλλοι τε θεοί)
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg. · also ἄλλον … ἄλλον, correlative: ’one … another’
ἄνασσε: ἀνάσσω — be lord over, rule (+ dat.); pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’rule!’
ἄντα: ἄντα — opposite, facing; adv. · also prep. + gen., ’opposite, over against’, following its noun
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄργεος: Ἄργος — Argos; neut. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
ἄσβεστος: ἄσβεστος — unquenchable, unceasing; masc. nom. sg.
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
ἐγγὺς: ἐγγύς — near, close by; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
ἐθέλῃσθα: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 2 sg., epic ending -ῃσθα (= Attic ἐθέλῃς)
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — in this place, to this place; adv.
ἐνοσίχθων: ἐνοσίχθων — earth-shaker, epithet of Poseidon (from ἔνοσις ’shaking’ + χθών ’earth’); masc. nom. sg.
ἐνώπια: ἐνώπια — the inner wall-faces of the porch (fixed architectural term); neut. acc. pl. · also the inner wall-faces of a hall: ’inner walls’ (πρὸς ἐνώπια παμφανόωντα ’against the shining inner walls’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’)
ἐπιτείλας: ἐπιτέλλω — enjoin, command, give orders; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having given orders’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐόντε: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom./acc. dual, epic ἐών (= Attic ὤν): ’the two being’
ἐῢς: ἐΰς — good, brave; masc. nom. sg., epic form (= Attic ἀγαθός), with πάϊς
ἑκάστῳ: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. dat. sg.
ἑκὰς: ἑκάς — far, far off; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’far from’
ἑκὼν: ἑκών — willing, of one’s own accord; adj., masc. nom. sg.: ’willingly’
ἑλιξάμενος: ἑλίσσω — turn, wheel; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’turning (himself) about’
ἑσταότ: ἵστημι — set; stand; perf. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἑσταότ’ = ἑσταότα, Attic ἑστηκότα): ’standing’
ἑταίρου: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. gen. sg., of cause with ἀχνύμενος: ’for the comrade’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of a companion’ (παραίφασις ἑταίρου ’a companion’s persuasion’)
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἔβη: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist (= ἔβη): ’went’
ἔγχεϊ: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ἔγχει)
ἔγωγε: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’I for my part’
ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
ἔνεικαν: φέρω — bring; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἤνεγκαν): ’they brought’
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπεσεν: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 sg. act., 2nd aor. ἔπεσον with the 1st-aor. ending: ’fell’
ἔρχομαι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. 1 sg.: ’I am going’
ἔσπασεν: σπάω — draw, pull out; aor. 3 sg. act., with ἐκ in tmesis: ’drew out’
ἔστι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., accented ἔστι at clause start: existential, ’there is’ · also impersonal + inf.: ’it is possible’ (οὐδέ πῃ ἔστι … εὐχετάασθαι)
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’
ἕκαθεν: ἑκάς (ἕκαθεν) — far off, from afar; adv., epic -θεν (= Attic πόρρωθεν)
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’
ἕκτορος: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam, chief Trojan hero; masc. gen. sg.
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἠέ: ἠέ — than (after a comparative); epic form of ἤ · also ἠέ = ἦε, ’or’, introducing a second question · also ἠέ, ’or’, introducing a further alternative in a list (ἠέ ποθι ’or somewhere’) · also ἠέ, ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠέ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’) · also ἠέ, ’than’, after a verb of wishing, with no comparative: ’rather than’ (δοῦναι κράτος ἠέ περ ἡμῖν ’to give strength rather than to us’) · also ἠέ … ἠέ, correlative ’either … or’, in a statement
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠμείβετ’ = ἠμείβετο)
ἤλυθες: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 2 sg., epic ἤλυθες (= Attic ἦλθες): ’you came’
ἤλυθον: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 1 sg., augmented, epic root ἐλυθ- with epenthetic -υ- (= Attic ἦλθον): ’I came’ · also aor. 3 pl.: ’they came, advanced’
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’
ἥν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. sg.: ’whom’; not the possessive · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν — her own; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’her own’ (θυγατέρα ἥν ’her own daughter’)
ἦλθες: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 2 sg., augmented: ’you came’
ἧκε: ἵημι — send, let go, let fall; aor. 3 sg. (with πρό in tmesis: ’sent forth’) · also with ἐξ in tmesis: ’sent out’ (ἐξ … ἧκε = ἐξῆκε) · also with ἐν in tmesis: ’sent in, let loose among’ (ἐν … κυδοιμὸν ἧκε ’sent uproar among’)
ἧσθαι: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. inf.: ’to sit’
ἰδομενεὺς: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, king of Crete, leader of the Cretans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἰδομενεῦ: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, leader of the Cretans; masc. voc. sg.
ἰδομενῆος: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, Cretan leader; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἱστάμενος: ἵστημι — set, stand; pres. mid. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’standing’
ἴδηαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. mid. 2 sg., epic -ηαι (= Attic ἴδῃ), after ἵνα: ’you may see’
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
ἴσχει: ἴσχω — hold, hold back, restrain (intensive of ἔχω); pres. 3 sg.
ἵκανε: ἱκάνω — come to, reach; impf. 3 sg.: ’came to, reached’
ἶσα: ἴσος — equal; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’equally’
ὀΐω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. (act. form ὀΐω, epic; = Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
ὀλύμπου: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, the mountain home of the gods; masc. gen. sg.
ὀμφαλόεσσαι: ὀμφαλόεις — bossed, with a central boss (ὀμφαλός); fem. nom. pl., epic -σσ-
ὀξέϊ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic ὀξέϊ (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind, backward, afterwards; adv. (= ὀπίσω)
ὀρέξατο: ὀρέγω — stretch out; mid. reach out for; aor. 3 sg. mid., + gen.: ’reached out for’
ὀρώρει: ὄρνυμι — rouse; perf. ὄρωρα intrans. arise; pluperf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’had arisen’
ὀτρύνεις: ὀτρύνω — urge on, stir up; pres. 2 sg. act.: ’you urge on’
ὁμίλου: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. gen. sg.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄκνῳ: ὄκνος — hesitation, reluctance; masc. dat. sg., dat. of cause: ’through hesitation’
ὄρεος: ὄρος — mountain; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted ὄρεος (= Attic ὄρους)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’how much, how far’
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’)
ὑπερμενέϊ: ὑπερμενής — overmastering, very mighty; masc. dat. sg., epic -έϊ (= Attic -εῖ)
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + gen.: ’on behalf of’ (ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν) · also + acc., ’beyond’ (ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’) · also + gen. of place, ’above’ (στέρνον ὑπὲρ μαζοῖο ’the breast above the nipple’) · also + acc. of motion, ’over’ (ὑπὲρ ὦμον ’over the shoulder’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ὑπὲρ σέθεν αἴσχε’ ἀκούω ’I hear shameful things about you’)
ὑψοῦ: ὑψοῦ — on high, high up; adv.
ὕπο: ὑπό — under, by; postpositive prep. (anastrophe) + gen.: ’under, at the stroke of’
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’)
ὦσε: ὠθέω — push, thrust; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔωσε): ’thrust’
ᾔει: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’was going, went’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
